title: City Council — April 1, 2025 Work Session and Business Meeting

votes.motion: MOTION: Council Member Holton moved to ADJOURN the City Council Work Session. The motion was seconded by Council Member Hyland

MOTION: Council Member Holton moved to APPROVE Resolution 2025-19 Approving and Ratifying a Drone Show Performance Contract with Open Sky Productions, LLC for 2025 Butlerville Days. The motion was seconded by Council Member Hyland. Vote on Motion: Council Member Holton – Yes; Council Member Hyland – Yes; Council Member Newell – Yes; Council Member Birrell – Yes

MOTION: Council Member Holton moved to APPROVE Resolution 2025-20 Approving a Firework Display Contract with Vortex Productions for 2025 Butlerville Days. The motion was seconded by Council Member Hyland. Vote on Motion: Council Member Hyland – Yes; Council Member Birrell – Yes; Council Member Holton – Yes; Council Member Newell – Yes

MOTION: Council Member Hyland moved to APPROVE Resolution 2025-21 Approving Appointments to the “Health in the Heights” Advisory Committee. The motion was seconded by Council Member Holton. Vote on Motion: Council Member Birrell – Yes; Council Member Holton – Yes; Council Member Hyland – Yes; Council Member Newell – Yes

MOTION: Council Member Holton moved to APPROVE Resolution 2025-22 Approving a Preliminary Official Statement Concerning the Issuance of Up to $30 Million of General Obligation Bonds for Refunding, City Improvements, and Related Matters. The motion was seconded by Council Member Hyland. Vote on Motion: Council Member Holton – Yes; Council Member Hyland – Yes; Council Member Birrell – Yes; Council Member Newell – Yes
MOTION: Council Member Hyland moved to TABLE the Consent Calendar to the April 15, 2025, City Council Meeting. The motion was seconded by Council Member Hyland
MOTION: Council Member Holton moved to ADJOURN. The motion was seconded by Council Member Hyland
